_comment: Usage examples and fuller descriptions for the docs site. Every command in install.sh's GUIDELINE_COMMANDS must have an entry here (enforced by scripts/build-docs.mjs). `summary` overrides the registry one-liner; `usage` is a list of example invocations.

oss-fix-issue.summary: Takes an issue from the project's tracker through to a pull request: parses the reference, branches with the project's naming convention, implements the fix (delegating to a coding agent when one is available), and opens the PR.

oss-analyze-issue.summary: Investigates an issue without changing code: reproduces the problem, locates the relevant code, and reports the findings and a suggested approach.

oss-create-issue.summary: Creates a new issue in the project's tracker (GitHub or Jira), gathering the title, type and details and confirming before filing.
usage: /oss-create-issue flaky timeout in the connection-pool test

oss-list-issues.summary: Lists the issues currently assigned to you in the project's tracker.

oss-find-task.summary: Finds an issue to contribute to, matched to an experience level through the project's task labels (e.g. good first issue, help wanted).

oss-fix-backlog-task.summary: Fixes a task tracked in a Backlog.md file (requires the Backlog MCP server). The backlog repository path is mandatory and is never assumed.

oss-triage-issue.summary: Maintainer-side triage of a filed issue: assesses validity, scope and labels and recommends next steps.

oss-create-multi-repo-issue.summary: Creates linked issues across several repositories for a change that spans more than one repo, cross-referencing them.

oss-fix-multi-repo-issue.summary: Fixes an issue whose work spans multiple repositories, coordinating branches and PRs across them from one canonical issue.

oss-review-pr.summary: Reviews a pull request against the project's rules and contribution standards, reporting findings constructively.

oss-address-review.summary: Addresses the review feedback on one of your pull requests, applying the changes and replying to the comments.

oss-review-prs.summary: Reviews a batch of the repository's open PRs in one pass, summarising each.

oss-pr-status.summary: Reports a PR's CI checks, review state and merge readiness; defaults to the PR for the current branch when none is given.

oss-list-pr-status.summary: Lists all your open PRs with a CI / review / merge-readiness summary for each.

oss-list-prs.summary: Lists all open PRs in the repository for browsing and review selection.

oss-merge-pr.summary: Merges a PR after verifying CI is green, discussions are resolved and approvals are met; squash-merges and deletes the branch.

oss-backport-pr.summary: Cherry-picks a merged PR onto a maintenance/release branch. The target branch is required; the remote defaults to origin.

oss-fix-ci-errors.summary: Downloads a failed CI run's reports, identifies the errors and fixes them; defaults to the latest failed run when no run id is given.

oss-fix-sonarcloud.summary: Fixes SonarCloud issues for a given rule using the project's component key; can target a specific branch.

oss-fix-github-alert.summary: Fixes a GitHub security or quality alert of a given type: code-scanning, dependabot or secret-scanning.

oss-quick-fix.summary: Applies a quick fix with no tracked issue (CI tweak, docs, dependency bump, ...), using the quick-fix branch and commit convention.
usage: /oss-quick-fix fix a typo in the README

oss-triage-security-report.summary: Triages an inbound security vulnerability report: assesses validity and scope and recommends a verdict.

oss-security-case.summary: Drives one security report end to end (triage, reporter reply, CVE reservation, sanitized issue, fix, backports and CVE draft), stopping at every maintainer gate. Runs as a Claude Code workflow (see Workflows below).

oss-analyze-third-party-cve.summary: Analyses the project's exposure to a CVE in a third-party dependency: checks the affected version ranges and maps the vulnerable APIs to actual project usage.

oss-draft-cve.summary: Drafts a project-specific CVE advisory page plus the matching CVE Record Format JSON, mirroring a template. The CVE id and template are required.

oss-create-security-advisory.summary: Opens a private GitHub security advisory (GHSA) to report a vulnerability, guiding through the required fields.

oss-update-gh-advisory-db.summary: Populates GitHub Advisory Database entries for the project's already-published CVEs.

oss-security-scan.summary: Scans the codebase for security vulnerabilities and reports findings; can be narrowed to a path.

oss-add-project.summary: Adds a new project to the OSS Helper by generating its rule files from a name and a short description.
usage: /oss-add-project wanaku a Java MCP router built on Quarkus

oss-install-info.summary: Installs a project's rule files from the known-projects repository for the current repo.

oss-create-rules.summary: Generates project rule files by auto-inspecting a repository (build tool, conventions, trackers).

oss-update-knowledge.summary: Updates a project's rule files from a URL (such as a CONTRIBUTING page) or a free-text description of its conventions.

oss-workspace-init.summary: Initialises a multi-repo workspace so the helper can operate across several related repositories.

oss-workspace-status.summary: Reports the status of every repository in the workspace (branch, local changes, sync state).

oss-qe-create-test-plan.summary: Creates a test plan for a project feature or component, written to <name>.md; optional guidance scopes it.

oss-qe-verify.summary: Executes an existing test plan and tracks results; accepts a plan name or a file path, plus optional phase guidance.

oss-qe-module-audit.summary: Deep-audits a module family for bugs, antipatterns, inconsistencies, missing features and new ideas.
